scope: OMP default-profile local Publish or Perish MCP for personal non-profit academic discovery and citation exports
approval: User approved the proposed local PoP connector and combination with writing skills; free services/accounts only, notify before any free-account API key expansion.

runtime.sdk_line: Original upstream v1 maintenance line; supports MCP through 2025-11-25, not the 2026-07-28 spec. Existing OMP stdio compatibility was exercised.

vendor.unused_companions: Original archive also contains pop8error.exe and pop8metrics.exe. pop8metrics.exe was observed without a signer; neither companion is executed by the connector.
vendor.license: Proprietary personal non-profit; original binary not modified or redistributed publicly.

capabilities.source_policy: Only currently enabled keyless public sources. The latter two are excluded from this implementation, not claimed to be inherently paid.
capabilities.max_results_target: 1 to 50; official PoP may round a provider batch upward; actual count is returned without inventing pagination/completeness
capabilities.export_behavior: Text only, no caller filesystem paths; session search_id; JSON snapshot or official offline cache exports with a JSON cache equality check
writing_routing: citation-management for identity, metadata, deduplication and citation styles
academic-paper-reviewer or academic-pipeline only when requested

checks: offline JSON, BibTeX, RIS and CSV exports retain DOI/title/count
empty PubMed search and empty export
final_smoke.known_paper_title: A Programmable Dual-RNA-Guided DNA Endonuclease in Adaptive Bacterial Immunity
final_smoke.cache_note: Real source HTTP responses were observed during development. Final smoke can use the isolated vendor cache; it is not claimed to refetch every source on every run.

host_integration.method: Actual omp --mode rpc --no-session --no-title --no-extensions --no-ui; get_state/get_available_commands and builtin /mcp reload
host_integration.existing_parent_conversation_mount: Still contains the pre-install device inventory; direct xd reads there returned No such tool. Reload or a new session is required; another process's reload is not asserted to reload the parent.

development_failures_not_hidden.cause: Extra APA export test expected plain text, but official PoP returned RTF with Unicode escapes.
development_failures_not_hidden.resolution: Keep the four formats in the approved proposal. APA/Vancouver/journal styles belong to citation-management/writing skills, not a new RTF converter.

development_failures_not_hidden.cause: Full PubMed title was tokenized by PoP into AND clauses including a/in. Cached NCBI XML contained Count=0 and PhraseNotFound=a,in.
development_failures_not_hidden.resolution: Expose the source limitation, preserve caller semantics, and verify discovery with distinctive title terms plus author/year. No automatic stopword removal, fake match or silent fallback.

development_failures_not_hidden.cause: Valid PubMed JSON contains an author object with name/affiliation among string authors. Initial schema rejected it.
development_failures_not_hidden.resolution: Accept and preserve the vendor's string-or-structured author representation; add a regression test. Final suite and smoke passed.

verification.observed_unrelated_warning: RTK upstream No hook installed detector warning remained visible; no generic rtk init or unrelated configuration change was performed.

security_and_privacy.transport: local stdio only; no HTTP listener or public endpoint
security_and_privacy.process: Fixed hash-checked executable; execFile with shell=false; explicit equals-form allowlisted arguments; source/format enums and bounded strict input schemas
security_and_privacy.child_environment: OS essentials and connector-local HOME/APPDATA/TEMP only; no inherited API keys, proxy environment or Node hooks
security_and_privacy.storage: Separate state directory; no access to GUI settings/results by the connector. Public queries, cached responses, cookies and vendor logs persist unencrypted without scheduled deletion.
security_and_privacy.external_data: Bibliographic text, links, TeX and CSV are untrusted. No automatic URL opening, PDF download, macro/formula execution, full-manuscript upload, or new telemetry was added by the connector.
not_claimed: full security audit or absence of vulnerabilities
free existing LLM subscription or internet service

rollback: Remove only the new MCP entry and PoP routing section, then reload. Preserve intervening user changes, GUI data and all other MCP integrations.
